title: 云是怎么来的 · 素材
subtitle: 给对比页用的单体素材
style: children's picture book illustration, soft pastel with powdery blended strokes and visible chalk texture, sky blue, cloud white and warm apricot

pages.scene: One single tall white cumulus cloud floating alone, its whole shape inside the picture. The background is one flat cream colour of a single even tone that fills the whole picture right out to all four edges. The object floats on this flat colour: it casts no shadow and rests on no ground, and there is no darker patch, wash, puddle, base, line or platform of any kind underneath it. There is no sky, no horizon, no clouds and no scenery of any kind behind it: the cream colour is the only thing behind the object, exactly as if the object had been cut out and laid on blank paper.
